verdict.rationale: The pricing page evidently lists concrete feature differentiators per tier (e.g., AskFred, real-time notes, audit logs, multi-language mode, team analytics) suggesting a self-serve, itemized pricing page rather than a sales-only wall, but the pack never shows actual dollar figures, an explicit 'Free' plan, or a statement confirming no sales contact is required for basic use. missing for 10: explicit free-tier existence/limits, listed price points per tier, and confirmation that upgrading doesn't require contacting sales.
